response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS average_difference FROM budget GROUP BY event_status), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_difference) AS average_of_status_averages FROM status_averages) SELECT event_status AS status, average_difference AS average, average_difference - average_of_status_averages AS average_minus_baseline FROM status_averages CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE average_of_status_averages IS NOT NULL AND average_difference IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: A status with no nonmissing amount − spent values has no defined average and is excluded from the baseline and results.
